coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable items (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity), model-configuration comparisons (prior/baseline versus chemical-feedback fine-tuning), and structural-diversity measurements including long carbon chains.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Substitutes a REINVENT experiment for the MOLGEN setup. Omits the fixed pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration, replaces ESR1/ACAA1 with DRD2/JNK3/GSK3β, and lacks the synthetic-versus-natural-product domain comparison. Reports general property statistics rather than top-three scores and omits the specified ESR1/ACAA1 binding-affinity improvements.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states MOLGEN's exceptionally high p-logP performance, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% and 70.4% improvements for ESR1 and ACAA1, or hallucination mitigation alongside maintained diversity.
